errors.text_span: “各语体中文配动词的一级语义域分布”
errors.evidence: The title for figure (a) is “各语体中支配动词的一级语义域分布” (distribution of governing verbs), not “各语体中文配动词的一级语义域分布” (distribution of Chinese matching verbs).
The second category on the x-axis is “传统文学” (Traditional Literature), not “科技文学” (Science and Technology Literature). This error is repeated throughout the description.
The categories on the x-axis (“新闻”, “传统文学”, “网络小说”, “微博”) are not sorted alphabetically by their Pinyin transliteration.

The description completely fails to mention that for each corpus type on the x-axis, there are two separate bars representing “男性” (male) and “女性” (female). This is a primary grouping variable in the chart.

errors.text_span: 图例位于右上角，列出了语义域名称及其对应的颜色，包括“动词（127）”、“动作（1452）”、“行为（1823）”、“交流（1260）”、“心理（1688）”、“认知（1165）”、“变化（1133）”、“存在（106）”、“其他（138）”等，其中数字为该语义域在整体中的频次总和
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the content of the legend. The categories listed (e.g., “动词”, “动作”, “行为”) and their associated numerical values are not present in the legend shown in the figure. The actual legend contains different categories like “感触”, “表情”, “管理” etc.

errors.text_span: “网络小说”的柱状图最高，总频次约为6753
errors.evidence: This value (6753) is the frequency for the 'female' bar only, not the total frequency for the 'Online Novels' category. The description incorrectly treats the female bar as the total for the category, ignoring the separate 'male' bar.

errors.text_span: 其主要由“行为”（蓝色，约4828）和“动作”（深蓝色，约1625）构成
errors.evidence: These component values for the 'Online Novels - female' bar in chart (a) are incorrect. Based on the percentages shown (92% and 2%), the values should be approximately 6213 (for the main blue segment) and 135 (for the top dark segment), not 4828 and 1625.
The category is incorrectly named. For the correct category, '传统文学' (Traditional Literature), the total frequency in chart (a) is 39 (male) + 192 (female) = 231, not 350.

errors.text_span: 其中“网络小说”最高，总频次约1000
errors.evidence: In chart (b), the 'Online Novels' female bar has a frequency of 6526 and the male bar has a frequency of 585. The value 1000 is grossly incorrect for either the individual bars or their total.
In chart (b), the value 666 corresponds to the 'female' bar in the '传统文学' (Traditional Literature) category, not the '新闻' (News) category. The frequency for the 'News' female bar is 790.

The category is incorrectly named. In chart (b), the lowest total frequency is for the 'Weibo' category (778), and the lowest single bar is for 'News - male' (97). The description is incorrect about which category is lowest and the value 100 seems to be an approximation of the lowest single bar, but attributed to the wrong category.
